design.name: StudyForge
design.question: How should limited study time be allocated to improve readiness across exams?
design.brief: Relative days · explicit deadlines · real planner output
design.classification: Example exam configuration and scheduling-engine estimates
design.north: Let a student inspect a constrained daily plan and the estimated recall trade-offs behind it.
design.layout: Archival academic chronicle led by a 21-day calendar; readiness and daily-cap ledger; topic curves and marginal-hour results.
limits: Day offsets are relative to the example planner start; no calendar date is invented.
Recall and objective gains are model estimates, not measured future exam performance.
The fixed example has three exams, 15 topics, a 120-minute daily cap and designated rest days.
The what-if sweep contains actual source-engine scenario outputs; browser interaction does not rerun the scheduling optimizer.

source: Committed repository data and reviewed dashboard arrays
